summary.text: Wendy Larson is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 7 who took office in January 2026 after winning a December 2025 special election, and she is seeking a full term on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as stay-at-home mother and corporate sales.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Larson was born in Wray, Colorado, and earned a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University in 1993.
Her career experience includes working as a stay-at-home mom and in corporate sales.
Larson has served as a member, deaconess and youth leader at Kiron Baptist Church, and has also served at the Mobile Food Pantry and on the Sac County Central Committee.
Larson ran for the Republican nomination for Iowa House District 7 in 2024 and lost to incumbent Mike Sexton, 1,320 votes to 1,373.
She won the December 9, 2025 special general election, defeating Democrat Rachel Burns, succeeding Mike Sexton, and assumed office on January 12, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments for 2025-2026 as Economic Growth, Technology and House Education.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she listed her key campaign messages as pro-life, the Second Amendment, and protecting children from the damaging effects of technology, along with focusing on education fundamentals and addressing the mental health crisis in children.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Rachel Burns in the general election.
